• Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations

Profile

• Good communication skills in English

 Employment Conditions

Battery Technician  Almere  € 3.400 - € 3.800 per month Would you like to work on innovative energy storage systems and contribute to the energy transition? As a Battery Technician, you will build, assemble and test modern battery systems used in sustainable energy solutions. In this role, you'll combine assembly work with electrical engineering and quality control. You'll work to clear instructions and ensure that every system is delivered in a technically sound and safe condition. You'll do this within a modern production environment where quality, technology and teamwork are key.  What are you going to do? As a Battery Technician, you will help with the construction and technical finishing of modern energy storage systems. - You will assemble and fit various components and systems; - You will connect electrical components, cabling and control panels; - You will read technical drawings and carry out work in accordance with clear work instructions; - You will check the systems and carry out quality and functional tests; - You identify anomalies and resolve simple technical faults.  Who are you? As a Battery Technician, you will have technical insight, work with precision and have an eye for quality and safety. - You will have at least an MBO level of working and thinking, preferably in the field of electrical engineering; - You have experience in assembly work or another technical role; - You can read technical drawings and apply them in your work; - You work meticulously and adhere to the applicable safety regulations; - You are proficient in Dutch or English.
